Climate Leaders Toast to a Hopeful Future at TIME100 Impact Dinner at COP31

At a TIME100 Impact Dinner on Nov. 10 during the annual U.N. climate conference, this year known as COP31, in Antalya, Türkiye, climate leaders spoke of the challenges and gains in the clean energy transition and the importance of bringing youth into the climate fight.
